description: This file defines the 'NotesController' class, which is a Spring REST controller responsible for managing CRUD operations related to notes. It provides endpoints to create, list, retrieve, update, and delete notes, interacting with a service layer and handling HTTP request/response mappings with OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: NotesController
classes.description: Spring REST controller that provides CRUD endpoints for note entities, annotated with Swagger/OpenAPI for documentation and validation annotations for request processing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note based on the provided NoteRequest DTO.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all notes.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note by ID.
